listing.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! GX Tag Force — Tag Force Recomp (Artknighty)
listing.summary: Early publicpreview. Upstream claims end-to-end play on mainly one machine/version/save, Story/field/dialogue/duels/DeckEdit/shop/saves/audio/video. No network/ad-hoc; logic30FPS, presentation60/120interpolationexperimental; APIs/formats/settings/folders maychange. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Own European ULES00600 v1.01 ISO; installed assets and generated C/jitcache kept locally. ISO is needed at installation, not after import.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Select plain TagForceRecomp-<version>-win64.zip, which README identifies as runtime/translator/TinyCC/FFmpeg without mods or textures. InstallandPlay imports own EUISO and locally translates/compiles into gen/jitcache; later Play noISOneeded. Mods/EnhancedTextures/Fullsplitpacks are separate optional downloads, not default selected payload.
